note: Runtime-loaded exact-model brand patterns for the affiliate eligibility gate and the transactional intent override. All values can be changed WITHOUT recompile — edit this file and restart the gateway. Each field has a sensible default applied when the file is missing or a field is absent, so an empty/missing file is NOT fatal. A query is an exact-model query when it contains a brand name followed by a model number (e.g. 'iphone 16', 'galaxy s24', 'pixel 9'). This is the eligibility gate for affiliate decoration: broad category queries ('best wireless earbuds') must never receive affiliate links.
